title: Noetherianity of canonical strict henselization
statement: Let R be regular and barY a geometric point of Spec R. The canonical strict henselization ring is Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 0EYG (pione-lemma-abhyankar-one-divisor), strict henselization paragraph; Tag 05WS (lemma-quotient-strict-henselization); Tag 06LN, regularity under strict henselization.

proof.text: Use the canonical small-to-full colimit comparison and its structural-map identity to apply the retained upstream regular divisor quotient theorem with divisor 0. Transport regularity back with the induced principal-quotient ring equivalence. The small-colimit quotient is the original strict henselization ring by the zero-ideal quotient equivalence; transfer Noetherianity across this equivalence. Obtain nontriviality from strictHenselizationLocalStructure, since IsLocalRing extends Nontrivial.
